card.name: Words introducing what something depends on
card.fires_on: Words that open an explanation of a relationship or aspect, such as 'how', 'role', 'number', 'factors', 'between' and 'function of'. They come after verbs like identify, discuss or examine, in descriptive text.

modes.label: how after a verb
modes.description: 'how' introduces a clause after identify or discuss.

modes.label: Nouns before of
modes.description: Nouns such as role, number or factors that begin a phrase about what relates to what.
modes.example: This course will examine the scientific basis of those predictions and the<< role>> of science in developing policy responses.

modes.label: Relationship words
modes.description: 'between' or 'of' in a phrase about a relationship or function.

card.writes: It lowers 'depends on' and 'depending' words in several languages, so it pushes away from a dependence phrase coming next.
card.plain: It fires on words that start to say how or what something relates to, where a 'depends on' phrase might otherwise follow.
